summary: Sivers Semiconductors AB (publ), through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells chips, components, modules, and subsystems in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company operates through Wireless and Photonics segments. It provides products based on semiconductor technology for 5G millimeter-wave networks, as well as optical semiconductors for fiber networks, wireless optical networks, and sensors. The company's products include radio-frequency integrated circuits, BFICs, radio frequency modules, and evaluation kits; and InP-based DFB lasers and gain chips as single emitters or arrays. Its products help its customers in various markets, such as AI datacenters, satellite communications, defense, and telecom. The company was founded in 1951 and is based in Kista, Sweden.
